title: GTM Associate
full_description:
About Heidi
Heidi is on a mission to halve the time it takes to deliver world-class care.
We believe that by 2050, every clinician will practice with AI systems that free them from administrative burdens and increase the quality and accessibility of care to patients across the world.
Built for clinicians, by clinicians, at the core of Heidi is its people. We are an eclectic bunch of inventors, builders, scientists, nurses, doctors, mathematicians, designers, creatives, and high-agency executors.
We achieve in 6 months what it takes our competitors 4 years to do. In just 12 months, 20 million patient consults were supported by Heidi, and we’re now powering more than 1 million consults every week.
With our most recent USD$16.6m round of funding from leading VC firms, we’re geared up to supercharge our ambitious growth, and we need a hungry, high-potential operator to help drive it.
The Role
You’ll be a founding member of our Germany team - working closely with our Germany Lead and Global Expansion Lead to unlock the market. You’ll have real ownership across every part of the business, and play a critical role in helping us win Germany.
What You’ll Do
You’ll operate as a true generalist, working across sales, business development, strategy, operations, marketing, and more
You’ll do whatever it takes to win Germany - this is a hands-on, fast-paced role with real ownership
You’ll be part of a high-expectations, high-support environment: we’ll push you hard, and back you fully
Supported by the Germany Lead and Global Expansion Lead, you’ll play a critical role in helping us win the market - beating local competitors and driving adoption at speed.
Your Scope Will Include
Owning the local sales process, tailored to align with our PLG motion
Collaborating with marketing to refine our brand, messaging, and field strategy for the German market
Securing strategic partnerships with key players across the local healthcare ecosystem
Building internal processes from scratch to enable repeatable execution across sales, ops, and GTM
Collecting customer and market feedback to shape our local playbook and inform commercial strategy
What We Will Look For
Is impeccably sharp and analytical, able to break down complex problems with structure while thinking creatively when needed
Acts like an owner - autonomous, accountable, and relentlessly outcome-oriented
Is an A-player - someone who consistently raises the bar and wants to be surrounded by others who do the same
Is exceptional with customers - emotionally perceptive, articulate, and comfortable spending 50%+ of their time in the field
Looking for uncapped growth - working in an environment where your ability to win defines the gradient of your growth
Bonus - experience in healthcare, sales, ops, consulting, or as a founder is a plus, but not required. We care more about horsepower and drive than your CV.
Attitude is more important than experience so if you are a hungry, competitive and highly motivated operator who has a knack for problem solving and building relationships we want to hear from you.
--
Über Heidi
Heidi hat die Mission, die Zeit zu halbieren, die benötigt wird, um erstklassige medizinische Versorgung bereitzustellen.
Wir sind überzeugt, dass bis 2050 jeder Arzt mit KI-Systemen arbeiten wird, die sie von administrativen Belastungen befreien und die Qualität sowie Zugänglichkeit der Versorgung für Patient:innen weltweit verbessern.
Entwickelt von Ärzten für Ärzte: Im Zentrum von Heidi stehen unsere Menschen. Wir sind ein vielfältiges Team aus Erfindern, Entwicklern, Wissenschaftlern, Pflegekräften, Ärzten, Mathematikern, Designern, Kreativen und umsetzungsstarken Machern.
Wir erreichen in 6 Monaten, wofür unsere Wettbewerber 4 Jahre brauchen. In nur 12 Monaten wurden 20 Millionen Patientenkonsultationen durch Heidi unterstützt und aktuell ermöglichen wir über 1.5 Million Konsultationen pro Woche.
Nach unserer jüngsten Finanzierungsrunde über 16,6 Mio. USD durch führende VC-Firmen sind wir bereit, unser ambitioniertes Wachstum weiter zu beschleunigen. Dafür suchen wir eine ehrgeizige, hochmotivierte Persönlichkeit mit Drive und Ownership.
Die Rolle
Du wirst ein Gründungsmitglied unseres Deutschland-Teams sein und eng mit unserem DACH-Lead und dem globalen Expansion-Lead zusammen, um den Markt zu erschließen. Du wirst echte Verantwortung in allen Geschäftsbereichen übernehmen und eine entscheidende Rolle dabei spielen, wie wir Deutschland gewinnen.
Was du tun wirst
Du arbeitest als echter Generalist – in den Bereichen Vertrieb, Business Development, Strategie, Operations, Marketing und mehr
Du tust, was immer nötig ist, um Deutschland zu gewinnen – das ist eine praxisnahe, schnelle Rolle mit echter Verantwortung
Du wirst Teil eines Umfelds mit hohen Erwartungen und starkem Support: Wir fordern viel – und unterstützen dich voll
Unterstützt von unserem DACH-Lead und dem globalen Expansions-Lead wirst du eine entscheidende Rolle beim Gewinnen des Marktes spielen – lokale Wettbewerber übertreffen und Adoption mit Tempo vorantreiben.
Dein Aufgabenbereich Umfasst
Verantwortung für den lokalen Vertriebsprozess, abgestimmt auf unsere PLG-Strategie
Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketing zur Schärfung unserer Marke, Botschaft und Regionalstrategie für den deutschen Markt
Aufbau strategischer Partnerschaften mit wichtigen Akteuren im lokalen Gesundheitssystem
Aufbau interner Prozesse von Grund auf, um wiederholbare Umsetzung in Vertrieb, Betrieb und Go-to-Market-Strategie zu ermöglichen
Sammeln von Kunden- und Marktfeedback zur Gestaltung unseres lokalen Playbooks und zur Information der kommerziellen Strategie
Was wir suchen
Ist außergewöhnlich scharfsinnig und analytisch, kann komplexe Probleme strukturiert aufbrechen und denkt kreativ, wenn nötig
Handelt wie ein Eigentümer – selbstständig, verantwortungsbewusst und kompromisslos ergebnisorientiert
Ist ein A-Player – jemand, der die Messlatte konstant höher legt und von anderen umgeben sein will, die das ebenfalls tun
Ist außergewöhnlich im Umgang mit Kunden, emotional feinfühlig, ausdrucksstark und bereit, über 50 % der Zeit im Außen- und Kundendienst zu verbringen
Sucht unbegrenztes Wachstum – Arbeit in einem Umfeld, in dem der eigene Erfolg das Entwicklungstempo bestimmt
Bonus
Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, Vertrieb, Betrieb, Beratung oder als Gründer ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Uns sind Energie und Umsetzungskraft wichtiger als dein Lebenslauf.
Einstellung ist wichtiger als Erfahrung – wenn du ein hungriger, wettbewerbsstarker und hochmotivierter Operator bist, der ein Händchen fürs Problemlösen und Beziehungsaufbau hat, dann wollen wir von dir hören.
Zur besseren Lesbarkeit verwenden wir das generische Maskulinum. Gemeint sind selbstverständlich alle Menschen, unabhängig von Geschlecht oder Identität.

title: Graduate Financial Analyst - Corporate Finance (Industrials)
full_description:
Business Unit:
Corporate Finance
Industry:
Industrials
Overview
Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.
Corporate Finance
The Houlihan Lokey Corporate Finance business has extensive expertise in mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, activist shareholder and takeover defense, and other related advisory services for a broad range of clients. In addition, we have the proven ability to engineer and execute financing solutions that are essential for growth and success and offer access to financing in the public and alternative capital markets through the issuance of debt, equity, or hybrid securities. In EMEA, we work with a wide spectrum of companies, from middle-market privately owned enterprises to large multinational organizations. With a growing platform of Corporate Finance professionals and offices across the region, in addition to our global reach and in-depth knowledge across a broad range of industries, we have the breadth and targeted expertise to provide exceptional client service.
Job Description
** Houlihan Lokey GmbH does not provide bank or securities brokerage services and is not subject to FINMA supervision. **
Our Industrials Group is seeking a Graduate Financial Analyst to join our Frankfurt team as part of the Houlihan Lokey Graduate Class of 2026.
Scope
Houlihan Lokey’s Industrials Group has built a reputation for providing a collaborative, team-based approach that puts its clients’ interests first and delivers superior outcomes in both M&A advisory and capital-raising assignments.
As a Graduate Financial Analyst you will work on corporate finance engagements for companies within our Industrials M&A advisory team based in Frankfurt. The group's engagements principally include sell-side and buy-side M&A transactions within the Industrials sector. As a dedicated member of our transaction team, you will be responsible for supporting these assignments. You will work with a talented, dedicated staff of professionals who will give you broad exposure to the many different issues and concerns affecting companies and investors today.
You will research and analyse financial statements, general economic conditions, industry-specific developments, acquisitions and divestitures, and investment attributes of publicly traded and private companies. You will also gain in-depth knowledge of capital raisings and financing structures.
Houlihan Lokey provides a collegial, entrepreneurial work environment. We reward our Financial Analysts with substantial responsibilities, interaction with senior-level professionals, and live engagements.
Requirements/Qualifications
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with fluency in both German and English is required (additional language skills are also advantageous)
Available to start full-time employment no later than July 2026
Must be in your final year of university (graduating in Summer 2026), or already graduated with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
Ideally 6+ months of internship experience in M&A, private equity, or other relevant industries
Strong quantitative and analytical skills with a focus on accuracy and attention to detail
An understanding of valuation theory, methodologies and applications
Strong financial and computer skills
Proficient use of Excel and PowerPoint
Strong interpersonal skills
Most importantly, we seek to attract dedicated, team-oriented candidates with a deep desire to win, a strong work ethic, and a willingness to work hard to achieve the highest standards of performance.
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Associate Consultant - Airline Strategy
full_description:
Oystin is looking to strengthen our growing Europe-based consulting team with an Associate Consultant - Airline Strategy. If you want to start your career as a consultant developing cutting-edge commercial strategies for airlines around the globe and navigate a new era of travel technology and AI, we look forward to your application.
What you’ll do
Conduct market and competitor analysis and ensure we stay up-to-date with industry trends and developments, including around AI
Participate in internal business development and industry research activities to strengthen our position as an industry thought leader and future-proof the way we work and our offering in light of AI
Conduct data analysis to identify and understand a problem and issues
Use research, interviews, and surveys, etc. to collect relevant data and subsequently draw conclusions
Help develop strategic recommendations for clients
Design high-quality presentations and documents to break down complex issues for client’s senior executives
Own your work packages within projects
Why it’s great to work with us
You’ll be part of an international, interdisciplinary and dynamic team of consultants in a company that is known for its industry thought leadership in one of the hottest topics of all of aviation
Our company culture is based on trust, transparency and continuous learning
You’ll have the chance to shape airline commercial and commercial IT strategies
You’ll be able to learn from experienced management consultants on exciting projects for clients across the globe
You’ll get to work with client’s C-Level and senior management
You’ll receive targeted training to acquire necessary skills
We have regular all-hands meetings, which provide a mix of learning and socialising for a team of more than 20 motivated consultants
You’ll work in a flexible hybrid office setup between home office, office in Frankfurt, and client’s offices
We offer flexible and fair working hours. We believe that consulting doesn’t mean working 60 hours a week
You’ll get to see many parts of the world and we’ll ensure that your travels and stays are comfortable
We offer a competitive salary and benefits package
What you’ll need to bring
A broad understanding of and interest in the airline and travel industry
A desire to learn and grow together with us in a changing industry and consulting environment due to AI
Undergraduate or master’s degree with 1-2 years of relevant work experience, for example in a consultancy or in a company within the airline or travel industry in a commercial or strategic function
Proficiency in spoken and written English
Knowledge of data analysis and research techniques, including relevant tools (e.g. Google Gemini, Claude or similar LLM,  MS Excel and PowerPoint, Tableau)
Ability and willingness to work in a hybrid setup e.g., work from home, office in Frankfurt and the client’s offices
Ability and willingness to travel globally and frequently for days or potentially up to two weeks at a time. Travel time is expected to be 20% and could be up to 40% of time
Oystin Advisory together with Travel in Motion
Oystin Advisory GmbH and Travel in Motion AG is a partnership of two leading aviation consulting firms. Our focus is on commercial aviation, and within that space, on airline distribution strategies, distribution platforms and technology. We help airlines and IT vendors enhance their distribution capabilities, enable retailing capabilities and understand their customers better. Our key clients are airlines around the globe, from full-service airlines to low-cost carriers, from industry heavyweights to airlines with a fleet of a handful of aircraft.

title: Demand Planning Analyst
full_description:
Job Title: Demand Planning Analyst
Location:
Munich
Department:
Supply Chain
Reports To:
Head of Demand Planning
Job Summary
The Demand Planning Analyst supports the demand planning team by assisting with forecasting, data analysis, and reporting to ensure accurate demand plans. This role is ideal for an early-career professional looking to develop analytical and supply chain planning skills while working closely with cross-functional teams such as sales, marketing, and operations.
Key Responsibilities
Assist in the creation and maintenance of demand forecasts using historical data, trends, and statistical tools
Analyze sales data and identify patterns, risks, and opportunities impacting demand
Support monthly and weekly demand planning cycles and forecast reviews
Prepare reports, dashboards, and KPIs related to forecast accuracy and demand performance
Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams to gather inputs and assumptions
Help monitor inventory levels and flag potential shortages or excess stock
Maintain planning data in ERP and demand planning systems
Document processes and support continuous improvement initiatives
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Business, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
Candidates must be based in Munich or open to relocating to Munich from within Germany.
At least 3-5 years of work experience in supply chain, planning, or data analysis in a fast-paced FMCG environment
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas, basic data analysis)
Exposure to ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) or demand planning tools
Knowledge of basic forecasting methods and KPIs (e.g., forecast accuracy, bias)
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools
Experience in SOP Calendar and submissions.
Business English fluent, knowledge of German is a plus
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
Good communication and collaboration skills
